intro: The order most of the game's paths lead you in. Optional areas are marked; bonfires are listed from the wiki's bonfire page with where each one is. Tap an area, boss or NPC for its card. Mini-bosses and ordinary enemies have no cards in this guide.

steps.t: Pull the [[Coiled Sword]] from [[Iudex Gundyr]] to start the fight, then carry it to [[Firelink Shrine]].
The hub. [[Fire Keeper]] levels you up, [[Blacksmith Andre]] upgrades and infuses, the [[Shrine Handmaid]] sells items and takes Umbral Ashes, [[Ludleth of Courland]] transposes boss souls.

Talk to [[Emma, High Priestess of Lothric Castle]] in the chapel. [[Greirat of the Undead Settlement]] is locked in a cell below the Tower on the Wall bonfire. For the [[Cell Key]]: from that bonfire go downstairs, drop a level, cross the rooftops with the Pus of Man, take the ladder down and pass the spear-wielding Lothric Knight. In the next room (Large Hollow Soldiers, two Starved Hounds, exploding barrels) the key is at the bottom of a small staircase, guarded by a hound. Once you hold a [[Pale Tongue]], [[Ringfinger Leonhard]] at the shrine gives the [[Lift Chamber Key]] for the locked door downstairs from the Tower on the Wall bonfire.
s: Emma, High Priestess of Lothric Castle

steps.t: Recruit [[Yoel of Londor]] at the crumbled bridge and free [[Cornyx of the Great Swamp]] from his cage. Meet [[Holy Knight Hodrick]] in the Pit of Hollows before you kill [[Curse-rotted Greatwood]]: get there in the metal cage on the back of the non-hostile Hollow Manservant at the top of the highest cliff. The Pit lies under the boss arena; its floor crumbles during the fight and Hodrick dies.

Meet [[Anri of Astora]] and [[Horace the Hushed]] near Halfway Fortress. [[Orbeck of Vinheim]] is in the Crystal Sage ruins; with 10 Intelligence he moves to the shrine. The [[Farron Coal]] is here too.
Cleansing Chapel bonfire: [[Slave Knight Gael]] prays here and opens the first DLC. Watch for [[Unbreakable Patches]] on the bridge. [[Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth]] resets stats in her bed chamber.
Put out the three flaming towers to open the way to the [[Abyss Watchers]], a Lord of Cinder. The [[Sage's Coal]] is in a small round building on the left of the keep.
Entering this area kills [[Yoel of Londor]]. Take all five Dark Sigils from him first if you want the Londor ending.
Optional. [[Horace the Hushed]] is in a cavern on the right side of the lake; what you tell [[Anri of Astora]] afterwards decides their quest.
[[Siegward of Catarina]] waits in the kitchen near the Distant Manor bonfire. [[Pontiff Sulyvahn]] is the area's boss.
[[Karla]] is in a locked cell (key from [[Profaned Capital]]). The [[Profaned Coal]] is in the cell with several Wretches opposite hers.
[[Yhorm the Giant]] is a Lord of Cinder; the [[Storm Ruler]] that beats him lies beside his throne. Free [[Siegward of Catarina]] from his cell first and talk to him so he joins the fight.
[[Aldrich, Devourer of Gods]] is a Lord of Cinder. The [[Giant's Coal]] is on the Giant Blacksmith in the west wing.
After the first three Lords of Cinder ([[Abyss Watchers]], Aldrich and Yhorm), [[Emma, High Priestess of Lothric Castle]] gives you the Basin of Vows and [[Dancer of the Boreal Valley]] appears.
[[Black Hand Gotthard]]'s corpse before the Grand Archives holds the Grand Archives Key.
Optional. Past [[Oceiros, the Consumed King]] an illusory wall leads down to [[Untended Graves]].
Optional. The [[Eyes of a Fire Keeper]] here unlock The End of Fire ending.

bosses: Lorian, Elder Prince and Lothric, Younger Prince
steps.t: Climb the archives to the Twin Princes at the top of [[Lothric Castle]]; their cinder is the last one.
s: Lorian, Elder Prince and Lothric, Younger Prince

steps.t: Optional. Ring the Great Belfry to summon [[The Nameless King]].
Place all Cinders of a Lord on their thrones and talk to the [[Fire Keeper]] to reach [[Soul of Cinder]]. Then pick an ending.

dlc.intro: Both expansions are optional. Ashes of Ariandel came first and The Ringed City follows on from it.

steps.t: Talk to [[Slave Knight Gael]] at the Cleansing Chapel bonfire in [[Cathedral of the Deep]] and touch the scrap of painting. [[Sister Friede]] (with [[Father Ariandel]]) is the end; the Gravetender fight is optional.
Use the bonfire at the start of the ramp in [[Kiln of the First Flame]], or the one that appears behind Friede's arena. Gael can be summoned for the [[Demon Prince]].

Tell [[Amnesiac Lapp]] about the Purging Monument before you fight Gael. [[Darkeater Midir]] is optional; [[Spear of the Church]] guards the Church of Filianore and [[Slave Knight Gael]] is the final boss.

endings.name: To Link the First Flame
endings.t: Beat [[Soul of Cinder]] and interact with the First Flame bonfire yourself without the Londor quest done. This is the default ending.

endings.name: The End of Fire
endings.t: Give the [[Eyes of a Fire Keeper]] from [[Untended Graves]] to the [[Fire Keeper]]. After the boss, do not touch the bonfire: use her summon sign next to it and let the scene play.

endings.name: To Take the First Flame
endings.t: Do The End of Fire, then strike the Fire Keeper while she holds the flame, before the screen fades.

endings.name: The Usurpation of Fire
endings.t: Finish the Londor quest: five Dark Sigils from [[Yoel of Londor]] before the [[Catacombs of Carthus]], then follow [[Anri of Astora]] and [[Yuria of Londor]] to the end. Interact with the First Flame yourself.
